title_sq: Ne Yzberisht, Shitet Apartament 1+1 , Ideal Per Investim Ose Banim !!!
description_sq: Ne Yzberisht, prane Kmy, ne ndertim te ri shitet apartament 1+1 me siperfaqe bruto 71.59 m2. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje ndertimi 9 katesh dhe organizohet nga korridori qe ben shperndarjen ne sallonin e bollshem bashke me kendin e gatimit me dalje ne ballkon, dhomen matrimoniale dhe 1 tualet qe aksesohet nga korridori. Disa nga cilesite e ndertimit: fasade e veshur me termoizolim, sistem kapot; dritare me dopjo xham me mbushje me gaz per minimizimin e zhurmave dhe termoizolim; izolim akustik ne ndarjet ndermjet apartamenteve; sistem kondicionimi multisplit, perdorim i pllakave dhe i dyerve i cilesise me te larte te importit. Apartamenti disponon dhe nje post parkimi ne katin -2 me cmim ekstra ne vleren 15.000 euro. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet ka marre nje zhvillim te vrullshem kohet e fundit si edhe ofron te gjitha facilitetet per nje jetese komode.
title_en: In Yzberisht, 1+1 apartment for sale, ideal for investment or residence!!!
description_en: In Yzberisht, near Kmy, in a new building, a 1+1 apartment with a gross area of ​​71.59 m2 is for sale. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a 9-story building and is organized by a corridor that divides into a spacious living room with a kitchenette with access to the balcony, a master bedroom and 1 bathroom accessed from the corridor. Some of the construction qualities: facade coated with thermal insulation, capot system; double-glazed windows with gas filling for noise reduction and thermal insulation; acoustic insulation in the partitions between apartments; multisplit air conditioning system, use of tiles and doors of the highest quality of import. The apartment also has a parking space on the -2nd floor with an extra price of 15,000 euros. The area in which it is located has received a rapid development recently and offers all the facilities for a comfortable life.
